observations.body: A solemn charge presses proclamation through changing hearers. I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
